# PiTTy v0.6.64

- **Smaller UI controller:** Built-in slash commands now run in `SlashCommandController`, not the central OpenTUI `App()` function.
- **Typed boundaries:** The controller accepts a minimal `SlashRuntime` and explicit UI hooks. Model metadata stays typed end-to-end.
- **Behavior unchanged:** Unknown slash commands still reach Pi, so extension, skill and prompt-template commands work. Model settings, compaction, session changes and display preferences retain their previous behavior.
- **Tests:** Six new focused command tests. Full local suite and cross-platform CI verify the refactor.

Upgrade with `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.64`. The staged update activates on the next launch without interrupting current agents.
